LLM rewrite.note: gemini-3.5-flash-lite, cached rewrites of the test queries (no API calls); not trained. Its formal column rewrites the formal queries too, since a deployed rewriter sees every query.

Query-DANN (bottleneck).note: the default adapter: zero-initialised residual bottleneck 1024 -> 128 -> 1024 on the frozen BGE-M3 query vector. Same adapter in "Query distillation score (bottleneck)".

Query-DANN (linear).note: --adapter linear: a single 1024 x 1024 linear map initialised to the identity. Same adapter in "Query distillation score (linear)".

TSDAE-SAPT (task queries), final.note: the encoder after the last training step, NOT the best dev checkpoint like the other rows: dev selection keeps step 50, which has barely trained and scores like base. This row shows what TSDAE training itself does to retrieval.

Query InfoNCE.note: --objective infonce: the full encoder fine-tuned with InfoNCE on informal queries against the frozen passage index, without the TSDAE reconstruction term that the method adds by default (weight 0.1).
